purpose: Combined StockWorker and ProfitWorker bounded-concurrency kind measurement
result: Failed at target10; 20 and30 not attempted after safety stop

workerConcurrency.basis: Qualified source hashes and packaged defaults; saved deployed configuration has no worker-concurrency override.

qualification.overallQualification: Failed; short diagnostic only. No sustainable capacity or causal worker comparison established.

phases.stockScope: First and last sampled post-warmup stock; phase-before-warmup stock unavailable unless separately captured.

limitations: Producer p95 is the final rolling 1024 new-write window, not an interval percentile.
Saga p95 and per-pod endpoint p95 may contain earlier samples; endpoint p95s cannot be added.
Rates use producer baseline-receipt to final-request-start monotonic duration; reader counters are sampled slightly later.
Missing evidence remains null. Sampled backpressure absence does not establish continuous absence.
Confirmed/cancelled deltas include completions of earlier pending writes; they need not equal accepted writes. Nonzero recovered deltas require manual replay review.
Reader outcomes come from interval logs, not starts/request counters. Fully contained reports omit boundary intervals.
SQL totals require all three shards. Drain evidence is associated by monotonic directory timestamp.
qualification.postAbortDrain: Not measured: safety abort restored controls and removed the disposable lab.

lastCompleteReaderWindow.limitation: Reader counter samples are taken shortly after producer timestamps. No interval outcome logs were collected after the safety abort.

resources.interpretation: Strong evidence of contemporaneous host paging pressure. A pool-wait bottleneck and causality for the failure are not established; sparse samples may miss short waits.

startup.note: One pre-measurement product restart followed a generator-registry read failure; underlying cause unconfirmed. Six live release scenarios subsequently passed.

comparisonLimit: Fresh inventory, database history, JVM age, host pressure and collector overhead differ from historical measurements. This short failure cannot establish worker regression or improvement. Stage A/B results remain separate.
